# client-properties

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from servlets/pf-integration/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/client-properties.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `client-properties` component of `servlets/pf-integration`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.servlet.clientregistration`: generated from its catalogue, [client-properties.json](../../servlets/pf-integration/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/client-properties.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `FEDERATION`, `AUTO_REGISTRATION`, `ATTESTATION_AUTH` ([components](../development/settings-catalogue.md#components)).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `status` (extended property) | Unset; one of `registered`, `auto_registered` | Who registered the client: registered (12.2 explicit) or auto_registered (12.1); a client without it was created by an administrator, and neither registration path touches it | **Per request**: Not declared in PingFederate: the registration is refused and the client disabled | Any | Yes |
| `trust_chain` (extended property) | Unset | The trust chain the client was registered with | **Not checked**: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side | Any | No |
| `application_type` (extended property) | Unset | application_type from the client's metadata | **Not checked**: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side | Any | No |
| `subject_type` (extended property) | Unset | subject_type from the client's metadata | **Not checked**: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side | Any | No |
| `contacts` (extended property) | Unset | contacts from the client's metadata | **Not checked**: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side | Any | No |
| `attestation_required` (extended property) | `false` | Written true when the client's metadata asks for client attestation. true: the client authenticates at the token endpoint only with an attestation, and a request for it without the OAuth-Client-Attestation header is refused (401 invalid_client) by the token-endpoint filter, which used to pass it to PingFederate's own client authentication | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): anything but true or false, lower case and unpadded (development also reads yes, no, on, off, 1, 0, TRUE and a padded value, with a warning) | Any | Yes |
| `federation_registration_expires_at` (extended property) | Unset; a whole number, at least 0 | When the registration ends, in epoch seconds: never later than its trust chain (12.3) | **Per request**: Written by this module; a value that is not a whole number is read, with a warning, as no expiry | Any | Yes |
| `federation_trust_anchor` (extended property) | Unset | The trust anchor the registration's chain reached; the token-issuance decision is asked with it | **Not checked**: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side | Any | Yes |
| `federation_entity_type` (extended property) | Unset; one of `openid_relying_party`, `oauth_client` | The Entity Type the client was registered from | **Not checked**: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side | Any | No |
| `federation_registration_disabled_at` (extended property) | Unset; a whole number, at least 0 | When this module disabled the client because its registration expired, in epoch seconds; only a client carrying it is enabled again by a renewal | **Not checked**: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_pop_max_age` (extended property) | `300`; seconds, at least 1 | The oldest a client attestation's proof of possession may be, for this client. Can only tighten the server's 300 s (no setting changes it): a larger value is refused | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): not a whole number, less than 1, or more than the server's | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_dpop_max_age` (extended property) | `300`; seconds, at least 1 | The oldest a DPoP proof presented with an attestation may be, for this client. Can only tighten the server's 300 s (no setting changes it): a larger value is refused | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): not a whole number, less than 1, or more than the server's | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_clock_skew` (extended property) | `60`; a whole number, at least 0 | The clock skew allowed when checking this client's attestation, in seconds. Can only tighten the server's 60 s (no setting changes it): a larger value is refused | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): not a whole number, negative, or more than the server's | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_challenge_required` (extended property) | `false` | Whether this client's attestation proof must carry a server-issued challenge. Can only tighten the server's policy (challenges optional): true requires one, false changes nothing | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): anything but true or false, lower case and unpadded (development also reads yes, no, on, off, 1, 0, TRUE and a padded value, with a warning) | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_expected_htu` (extended property) | Unset | A pin of the htu a DPoP proof names at the token endpoint. Can only pin: it must be the token endpoint's URL as PingFederate advertises it (its token endpoint base URL, else its issuer, then /as/token.oauth2) or the issuer followed by /as/token.oauth2 | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): not an absolute http or https URL without query or fragment, or a URL this server does not answer at for the token endpoint | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_accepted_algs` (extended property) | `RS256,RS384,RS512,PS256,PS384,PS512,ES256,ES384,ES512,EdDSA`; a list | What this client's attestation may be signed with, comma-separated. Can only narrow the server's list (the default): the algorithms kept are those in both | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): empty, or none in common with the server's list | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_pop_algs` (extended property) | `RS256,RS384,RS512,PS256,PS384,PS512,ES256,ES384,ES512,EdDSA`; a list | What this client's attestation proof may be signed with, comma-separated. Can only narrow the server's list (the default): the algorithms kept are those in both | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): empty, or none in common with the server's list | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_dpop_algs` (extended property) | `RS256,RS384,RS512,PS256,PS384,PS512,ES256,ES384,ES512,EdDSA`; a list | What a DPoP proof with this client's attestation may be signed with, comma-separated. Can only narrow the server's list (the default): the algorithms kept are those in both | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): empty, or none in common with the server's list | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_required_claims` (extended property) | Unset; a list | Top-level claims this client's attestation must carry, comma-separated. Can only add to the claims every client's attestation must carry (oidf.attestation.required.claims or OIDF_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED_CLAIMS) | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): a list of nothing; a claim the attester does not send refuses every attestation | Any | Yes |
| `trust_chain_leaf_max_time` (extended property) | `-1`; a whole number | The longest the leaf's Entity Configuration in a presented chain may live, in seconds, at the OGNL chain criterion; -1 is no limit | **Per request**: Not a whole number: the default, with a warning | Any | Yes |
| `trust_chain_trustanchor_max_time` (extended property) | `-1`; a whole number | The longest the trust anchor's statement in a presented chain may live, in seconds, at the OGNL chain criterion; -1 is no limit | **Per request**: Not a whole number: the default, with a warning | Any | Yes |
| `trust_chain_request_max_age` (extended property) | `60`; a whole number | The oldest a statement in a chain presented at the token endpoint may be, in seconds; -1 is no limit. The attestation criterion's default is -1, not 60 (F-0199) | **Per request**: Not a whole number: the default, with a warning | Any | Yes |
